changelog: LLM provider polish and agentic runtime controls
Settings now uses LLM naming for the assistant configuration and floating assistant entrypoint.
Added Perplexity (Sonar) as a first-class LLM provider.
changelog_es: LLM provider polish and agentic runtime controls
Settings now uses LLM naming instead of AI Chat/Chat IA for the provider-backed assistant experience.
Added Perplexity (Sonar) as a first-class LLM provider. Sonar calls use Perplexity's Sonar endpoint and model loading uses the current `/v1/models` catalog with
The provider model picker now filters to useful text/chat models and excludes image, audio, embedding, moderation and unrelated diagnostic models such as Nano B
